items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: my drum teacher was Cie Frazier

ctx.x: Yes. It's an amazing thing. I've never been able to pinpoint why that is. I mean, my drum teacher was Cie Frazier, from the Preservation Hall Band nowadays. But I didn't want to play like him. But now the average guy, they want to play like Ram Hall or Zutty or this and that.
